title: Fan Favorites Rewind, Vol. 2
theme: More classic Inside the Magic-style categories
intro: [excited] We're back with more fan-favorite categories! Toads, news anchors, props, ABCs, and rhymes. [laughs] It's a grab bag of greatness tonight!

art.prompt: A retro game-show stage with glowing blue screens, an old film reel, a stack of storybooks, and gold confetti in spotlights Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Merrily on Our Way
categories.intro: [excited] Two stories, one movie! It's The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad. [laughs] Hold on to your hats, and your heads.

art.prompt: A split scene: on the left a vintage red motorcar racing down an English country lane past a grand manor, on the right a spooky moonlit covered bridge with a glowing carved pumpkin Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This Disneyland dark ride, an opening-day attraction in 1955, is based on the film's half about a reckless amphibian.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Mr. Toad's Wild Ride! It ends with you literally driving into the underworld. Fun for the whole family!

clues.clue: Bing Crosby narrates the half of the film based on this Washington Irving story.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Legend of Sleepy Hollow! [whispers] Bing makes it sound so cozy. It is not cozy.

clues.clue: In the film's big chase, the Headless Horseman hurls this flaming object at poor Ichabod Crane.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is a pumpkin! A flaming jack-o'-lantern, right at his head. Ichabod, buddy, just stay home on Halloween.

clues.clue: Toad's loyal and rather posh horse goes by this name.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Cyril Proudbottom! Best horse name in Disney history. I will not be taking questions.

clues.clue: This sneaky tavern keeper is the real thief who steals the motorcar and lets Toad take the blame.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mr. Winky! Shady tavern owner, in cahoots with the weasels. Never trust a guy named Winky.

categories.title: Stop the Presses
categories.intro: [excited] Breaking news, everybody! This category is all about newsrooms, anchors, and reporters across the Disney world. [laughs] Back to you, Tom.

art.prompt: A vintage TV news desk under studio spotlights with two empty chairs, a retro microphone, a stack of newspapers, and a city skyline backdrop Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Disney owns this sports network, whose four letters originally stood for Entertainment and Sports Programming Network.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is ESPN! [chuckles] Disney has the mouse and SportsCenter. Talk about a full schedule.

clues.clue: Robin Roberts has co-anchored this ABC morning show since 2005.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Good Morning America! Good morning to you too, Robin.

clues.clue: In the U.S. version of Zootopia, the ZNN news co-anchor is this antlered animal. In Japan, it's a raccoon dog instead.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is a moose! Different countries got different anchors, so a panda in China and a koala in Australia. Global news, literally.

clues.clue: At the start of Up, young Carl watches a newsreel about this famous explorer, his childhood hero.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Charles Muntz! Never meet your heroes, especially if they have a pack of talking dogs.

clues.clue: Disney comics turned this 1930s mouse into a newspaper reporter, Mickey's sister, and the mom of Morty and Ferdie.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Felicity Fieldmouse! Mickey has a big sister. Most of you did not know that, and that's why this is a thousand points.

categories.title: Mickey's Prop Closet
categories.intro: We raided Mickey's prop room! [whispers] Don't tell him. I'll show you a prop, you name the Mickey film or short it's from.

art.prompt: A cozy backstage prop room with shelves of a ship's wheel, a starry wizard hat, a magic bean, a Victorian top hat, and a velvet crown, warm lamp light Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This prop calls back to Mickey's 1928 steamboat cartoon. Name the short.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Steamboat Willie! Mickey's big debut with synchronized sound. Toot toot!

media.prompt: A wooden ship's steering wheel on the deck of an old paddle-wheel riverboat with smokestacks puffing, black-and-white film grain Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Name the 1940 film where this hat causes a lot of trouble.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Fantasia! The Sorcerer's Apprentice. Never borrow your boss's hat. Or his brooms.

media.prompt: A tall deep-blue wizard's cone hat with silver stars and a crescent moon, beside two wooden buckets overflowing with water on a stone staircase Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mickey trades the family cow for these. Name the 1947 package film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fun and Fancy Free! Mickey and the Beanstalk. [chuckles] Bad trade, great beanstalk.

media.prompt: A small pile of three glowing magic beans in an open palm-sized wooden box, a giant green beanstalk climbing into the clouds behind Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mickey plays Bob Cratchit in this 1983 short, where this prop matters a lot.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Mickey's Christmas Carol! A little crutch by the fireplace. Excuse me, I have something in my eye.

media.prompt: A small wooden crutch leaning against a warm Victorian brick fireplace with stockings and a tiny Christmas tree, snow at the window Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mickey plays two roles in this 1990 short where a crown swaps owners.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Prince and the Pauper! Mickey plays the prince and the pauper. Double the Mickey, double the fun.

media.prompt: A golden jeweled royal crown resting on a pile of patched, ragged peasant clothes on a castle flagstone floor, torchlight Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: A-to-Z Attractions
categories.intro: [chuckles] It's spelling bee time! I'll name four attractions. You tell me which one comes first in alphabetical order. Ignore the spaces, trust your ABCs.

art.prompt: Colorful wooden alphabet blocks stacked like a castle, a tiny monorail track looping around them, theme park lights twinkling at dusk Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Alphabetize this! Which comes first: Haunted Mansion, Space Mountain, Dumbo the Flying Elephant, Peter Pan's Flight?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Dumbo the Flying Elephant! D comes before H, P and S. Fly, baby, fly.

clues.clue: Alphabetize this! Which comes first: Soarin', Test Track, Mission: SPACE, Frozen Ever After?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen Ever After! F beats M, S and T. [laughs] Let it go, everyone.

clues.clue: Alphabetize this! Which comes first: Kilimanjaro Safaris, Expedition Everest, Na'vi River Journey, DINOSAUR?
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is DINOSAUR! D before E. The dinosaurs win again. They usually do.

clues.clue: Alphabetize this! Which comes first: Star Tours, Slinky Dog Dash, Spaceship Earth, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train?
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Seven Dwarfs Mine Train! S-E beats S-L, S-P and S-T. Heigh-ho, heigh-ho.

clues.clue: Alphabetize this! Which comes first: Mickey's PhilharMagic, Main Street Vehicles, Magic Carpets of Aladdin, Mad Tea Party?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mad Tea Party! M-A-D beats M-A-G and M-A-I. Spin me right round, baby.

categories.title: Rhyme Crimes
categories.intro: [laughs] It's rhyme time! Every answer is two rhyming words, and one of them is a Disney name. Make it rhyme or make it fine.

art.prompt: A whimsical storybook page exploding with swirling musical notes, quills, ink pots and bouncing rhyming paper hearts on a starry purple background Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Rhyme time: the scent of Beauty and the Beast's bookworm heroine.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Belle smell! Probably old books and fresh bread. Lovely.

clues.clue: Rhyme time: the sound Pooh's gloomy donkey pal makes while he naps.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Eeyore snore! [sighs] Thanks for noticin' me.

clues.clue: Rhyme time: the reading material of Peter Pan's pirate enemy.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Hook book! Probably titled Ticking Crocodiles and How to Avoid Them.

clues.clue: Rhyme time: the place where the giggly hyena from The Lion King sleeps.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Ed's bed! Ed never says a word, but I bet he laughs in his sleep.

clues.clue: Rhyme time: a little gadget belonging to Ratigan's peg-legged bat in The Great Mouse Detective.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Fidget's widget! Basil would deduce it in seconds. You did too. Probably.
